scope: Theorem 6.2 (Deterministic additive approximation) of the manuscript “The approximation threshold for metric k-median” (preprints/The-Approximation-Threshold-for-Metric-k-Median-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 125 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c8176d1671beb83d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 33. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every fixed ε > 0, there is an instance- independent integer c ≥ 0 and a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm for metric k-median that opens at most k + c facilities and has total connection cost at most ( 1 + 2 e + ε ) LP, where LP is the optimum value of the assignment relaxation. In particular, its cost is at most the same factor times OPTk.
